platform: 95bFM Auckland Lossless Stream-and-Download Airplay Submission Route
manual_review_reason: 95bFM's current official Submit Music page instructs artists to use the station's dedicated music-submissions email link and include both a streaming link and a download link to a lossless WAV or FLAC file. The stream and download must not require an account, password or platform login, and Spotify is explicitly unsuitable. The destination address is protected by Cloudflare on the official pages and was not decoded, guessed or stored. A human must open the authorized email link, confirm the current destination and international eligibility, choose a suitable MarcsMusic track, ensure the stream and non-expiring lossless download are accessible without authentication, provide artist name, song title, origin and release date, verify rights, content labels and current AI-origin policy, and send manually. Tracks older than one month remain submittable but are no longer eligible for high-rotation A/B playlisting.

platform: RadioActive.FM Wellington Music Submission Email and Physical Delivery Route
manual_review_reason: RadioActive.FM's official Contact page publishes music@radioactive.fm specifically for Music Submissions and also authorizes posting music to the station. The page does not state accepted codecs, bitrate, attachment versus download-link rules, release-age limits, metadata, rights language, AI-origin policy, international eligibility or response expectations. A human must reconfirm the current rules, select a genre-appropriate MarcsMusic release, confirm whether email delivery should use a stream, lossless download or another method, avoid unsolicited attachments unless explicitly permitted, verify rights and content labels, and send manually. Any physical package also requires human preparation and postage.
